description.value: Brazza Gelato & Coffee is an Italian-style cafe on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver serving authentic European espresso drinks alongside an extensive selection of handcrafted gelato and sorbetto made in-house daily. The menu also includes freshly baked croissants, scones, strudels, and panini and croissant sandwiches, making it a well-rounded stop for cyclists needing a real meal or a sweet treat. The shop sits on a busy pedestrian corridor with public bike racks directly on the Lonsdale Avenue sidewalk out front.
